reason: Native adoption retains tests/src/e2e/workflows/auto_backup/test_capture_and_restore.py::TestEntityRegistryCaptureRestore::test_entity_registry_full_loop relative to upstream 1c4b4edfc. It verifies capture/restore of a seeded entity's registry hidden flag through the public tools. Its external_only gate is required because auto-backup settings change in the pytest process, so it adds one collection-time skip on all seven out-of-process lanes. The four duplicated label/category/zone/area scenarios were removed from this monolith; their canonical upstream versions remain in test_registry_capture_restore.py and add no new skips. Native lane keys inherit these deltas; their three legacy raw-transport skips are already owned by native-runtime.json.
